{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and converted orders
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
n_converted = loyal_df['converted'].sum()

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_loyal

# Print all necessary values
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted orders among loyal: {n_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
